name: Additive trusted private food runtime capability exposure
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
objective: Expose the existing authorized service and separate operation gate from one concrete service instance through additive runtime factories without changing existing consumers or activating infrastructure.
preservedContracts: Existing FOOD-001E/F/G factory names, input types, narrow return types, failure shapes/messages and consumers remain unchanged and source-compatible.
All existing narrow factory validation, ordering, delegation and behavior remain intact; K is strictly additive.
FOOD-001D/D2 authorization and FOOD-001J parsing semantics remain unchanged.

capabilityBundle.definition: export interface FoodPrivateDraftRuntimeCapabilities { readonly service: FoodPrivateDraftService; readonly gate: FoodPrivateDraftOperationGate; }
capabilityBundle.resultDefinition: export type FoodPrivateDraftRuntimeCapabilitiesResult = Readonly<{ ok: true; value: Readonly<FoodPrivateDraftRuntimeCapabilities> }> | Readonly<{ ok: false; error: Readonly<{ code: 'configuration-unavailable'; message: 'Food draft runtime configuration is unavailable.' }> }>;
capabilityBundle.exposure: Only service and gate; no database, repository, session, resolver, principal, administrator or token fields. The capability object is frozen/read-only.
capabilityBundle.controller: Keep FOOD-001I controller separate; do not include or construct it in K.

sameInstanceGuarantee: Exactly one SingleAdminFoodDraftService instance per successful capability-factory invocation; exactly one repository per successful E composition.
bundle.service and bundle.gate reference the same concrete instance: bundle.service === bundle.gate.
The concrete service is statically known to implement both interfaces. Never cast a merely narrow FoodPrivateDraftService into a gate.
No second service, second administrator input, duplicated caller resolver configuration or duplicated authorization policy.
Return a frozen capability object equivalent to Object.freeze({ service, gate: service }).
compositionE: Permit a private internal validated construction helper shared by the existing narrow factory and new capability factory.
The helper constructs one D1FoodDraftRepository and one SingleAdminFoodDraftService from existing injected dependencies.
Existing narrow composition returns only its existing narrow service contract; new composition returns the service/gate bundle.
Preserve all structural input validation, canonical administrator validation, throwing-getter handling, fixed configuration failure and synchronous zero-I/O construction.
acquisitionF: Share existing trusted environment validation between narrow and capability entry points.

F exclusively validates exactly RIVER_FOOD_DB and RIVER_FOOD_ADMIN_PRINCIPAL_ID. No alternate or fallback keys, administrator trimming/normalization/defaults/inference, or expected-origin configuration.
Preserve existing validation ordering, exact original environment forwarding where required and fixed configuration-unavailable semantics.
The narrow factory retains its current composition delegation; the companion delegates through the new capability composition path.
serverContextG: Share existing identity-dependency validation and request-scoped resolver construction between narrow and capability entry points.
Preserve RIVER_IDENTITY_DB validation, existing session shape validation, optional now semantics and exact original environment forwarding.
Every invocation constructs fresh AstroPrincipalSessionStore, D1PrincipalRepository and DefaultSessionPrincipalResolver instances.
The narrow server-context factory retains current behavior exactly; the companion delegates through the new F capability acquisition path.
Perform zero construction-time session, identity/food database or service calls. Do not probe prepared statements or clocks.
construction: Existing and companion factories are synchronous and I/O-free; structural checks only.

Do not invoke session reads/writes, principal resolution, clocks, prepared statements, repository operations, service operations, gate callbacks, controller operations or J parser/body readers during construction.
Structural success is not authentication, authorization, database/schema readiness, migration readiness, sellability or sale readiness.
Never cache or transfer an authorization decision. Subsequent service and gate calls retain fresh D/D2 authorization and revocation behavior.

laterAssembly.status: Architectural compatibility only; not implemented by K
laterAssembly.transport: const transport = createPrivateFoodDraftMutationRequestBoundary({ gate: capabilities.gate, controller, expectedOrigin: trustedExpectedOrigin });
laterAssembly.expectedOrigin: Later trusted HTTP/route integration owns acquisition. Add no expectedOrigin to the bundle, E inputs, F acquisition or G adapter.
laterAssembly.isolation: K constructs neither I nor J and knows no method, Origin header, request body, content type, cookies, redirect URL or HTTP response semantics.

failureSeparation: Capability composition/acquisition failures use only configuration-unavailable and exactly Food draft runtime configuration is unavailable.
Keep construction failures separate from D access failures, D2 callback-failed, J transport failures and repository/storage failures; never merge or reinterpret them.
Fixed sanitized configuration failures expose no dependency values, administrator values, exceptions, stack traces or internals.
implementationScope: Six existing files only. Current design requires no additional implementation module; any necessity for another module must first be demonstrated through specification validation and resolved before implementation.
requiredTests: Success through all three capability factories; frozen/read-only bundle with service === gate.
Instrument construction to prove exactly one concrete service and one E repository, with one administrator and caller-resolver configuration.
Existing narrow outputs, failure shapes/messages, validation ordering and delegation behavior remain identical; existing consumers remain source-compatible.
Malformed structural dependencies and throwing getters retain fixed sanitized configuration-unavailable behavior.
Exact environment reference/forwarding and existing key-validation ownership preserved.
Fresh request-scoped identity components per G invocation with no cross-request authorization cache.
Zero construction-time I/O, clock calls, gate callback execution, controller calls or parser/body-reader calls.
Fresh D/D2 authorization and revocation remain intact; gate success never supplies reusable mutation permission.
Trusted manual I/J assembly preserves authorization-before-body-read and subsequent fresh mutation authorization.
Source isolation: no HTTP parsing/request handling, configuration mutation, configured D1 access, infrastructure activation or unrelated subsystem changes.
futureImplementationValidation: Strict TypeScript checks for modified files
excludedScope: Routes/actions/pages/components, navigation, HTTP status mapping, redirects and request parsing.
Origin acquisition/configuration, CSRF changes and FOOD-001J semantic changes.
RIVER_FOOD_DB provisioning/configuration, migration execution, real administrator configuration, Wrangler changes and runtime activation.
Public product pages, commerce/checkout/Stripe, fulfillment/accounting/community features.
Deployment, production data and insurance/Sesh/creator or unrelated changes.
currentTaskBoundary: Create only this specification. Do not implement, stage, commit, configure infrastructure, migrate, access configured D1 or deploy.
nextStep: Review the specification before separately authorizing the six-file additive capability exposure implementation.
